audit.whatIsWrong: Chart handed Mordekaiser every row from level 3 onward, contradicting a 55.83% Warwick win rate and the mirror.
audit.why: Mirror audit (mordekaiser/warwick) already applied the shared chart Skill / Mordekaiser / Warwick / Warwick / Mordekaiser / Warwick / Warwick. Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage, which is exactly what Mordekaiser's HP-and-shield profile does not answer; his only true win row is the 140/120/100s Realm of Death.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the mirror chart as matched pairs, with ratings and the contradicting why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and late spikes said his shield out-sustains you.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Jaws of the Beast is percent-max-health; stacking HP and a stored-damage shield does not scale against it. His spike is the ult cooldown, not items.
audit.corrected: Re-keyed the item spikes to max-health damage versus Indestructible, and made Realm of Death's cooldown the thing to track.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated or mis-slotted ability names: 'Death Realm' for the ult, 'Indestructible (E)' for the shield, and 'Grasp of the Undying (E)' for the pull.
audit.why: Riot data: R is Realm of Death, W is Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s, stored-damage shield he can consume to heal), E is Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s pull). Grasp of the Undying is a rune, not an ability.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence renamed across both layers, with real cooldowns attached. Also removed 'follow his dash' — Mordekaiser has no dash. Deliberately did NOT assert that Obliterate grounds: the derived grounding flag contradicts Riot's own description, which mentions only damage (same flag misfire the mirror flagged).

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger answers his Obliterate chip, but Darkness Rise turns on after three hits and burns you down — level 1 is genuinely even.

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: At 2 Obliterate plus Death's Grasp is more damage than your one-point Jaws — concede the level-2 window and farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Blood Hunt speed plus Jaws' max-health bite out-trades him while his Indestructible (8-12s) is down.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death drags you into an isolated 1v1 and steals your stats for its duration; his 140s R is the whole level-6 window — do not fight into it.

edits.before: Morde's Obliterate poke and passive trade evenly with your sustain at level 1.
edits.after: Obliterate poke and Darkness Rise trade evenly with Eternal Hunger at level 1.

edits.before: Level 2 is a skill coin-flip before his shield is leveled up.
edits.after: At 2 his Obliterate and Death's Grasp out-trade you pre-Blood Hunt.

edits.before: At 3 your W-empowered burst out-trades him while his E shield is down.
edits.after: At 3 Blood Hunt plus sustain out-trades him while Indestructible is down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tip to Morde as his Indestructible shield and passive scale.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours: Jaws' max-health bite beats his shield stacking.

edits.before: Death Realm at 6 isolates you into a stat-stealing 1v1 he wins.
edits.after: Realm of Death at 6 isolates you into a stat-stealing 1v1 he wins.

edits.before: A first item lets his shield out-sustain your on-hit damage.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King's max-health hits out-pace his shield.

edits.before: Late Morde's R, passive shred, and stat-steal beat you in every duel.
edits.after: Away from his 100s ultimate you win the duel on max-health damage.

edits.before: You own the level-3 window before Morde snowballs: his Obliterate (Q) is his only real damage and it's dodgeable, so W-empowered Jaws plus Eternal Hunger sustain out-trades him while his Indestructible (E) shield is on cooldown.
edits.after: You own the level-3 window before Morde snowballs: Obliterate (Q) is his main damage and it is dodgeable, so Blood Hunt speed plus Eternal Hunger sustain out-trades him while Indestructible (W, 8-12s) is on cooldown.

edits.before: Death Realm (R) flips the matchup — it drags you into an isolated 1v1 where his passive rune stacks and shield sustain snowball, and he steals a chunk of your stats, so avoid fighting him at full mana past 6.
edits.after: Realm of Death (R) flips the matchup — a 140s cooldown that drags you into an isolated 1v1 where Darkness Rise and Indestructible snowball, and he steals a chunk of your stats, so bait it before you commit.

edits.before: With a first item Morde's passive AoE and Indestructible shield out-sustain your on-hit damage, and Death Realm becomes a guaranteed pick if he lands Grasp of the Undying (E) pull into ult on you.
edits.after: With a first item Blade of the Ruined King's max-health hits out-pace Indestructible, but Realm of Death is still a guaranteed pick if he lands the Death's Grasp (E, 16-8s) pull into ult on you.

edits.before: Late Morde is a bruiser-mage who wins every Death Realm 1v1: his shield heals off your damage, his passive shreds you, and he steals your AD/AP for the duration, so never get isolated by his R.
edits.after: Late Morde is a bruiser-mage who wins every Realm of Death 1v1: Indestructible heals off your damage, Darkness Rise shreds you, and he steals your stats for the duration, so duel him only with his R down.

edits.before: Level 3 is your one clear window — W-empowered Jaws plus sustain out-trades him while his E shield is down. From 6 onward Death Realm isolates you and his shield-sustain snowball takes over.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are yours — Blood Hunt speed plus Jaws' max-health bite out-trades him while Indestructible is down. At 6 Realm of Death isolates you, so hold Primal Howl and fight once it is spent.

edits.before: Once Morde has items and R he dominates: Death Realm drags you into a 1v1 where his passive shreds you, his shield heals off your damage, and he steals your stats, so never let him isolate you.
edits.after: Items suit you: max-health damage beats his health and shield, and Realm of Death is a 100s cooldown — duel him the moment it is spent, avoid him while it is up, and the side lane is yours.

edits.before: Keep mana for E to break his Grasp pull before R
edits.after: Hold Primal Howl for his Death's Grasp pull into R

edits.before: Isolate you with Death Realm for a stat-stealing 1v1
edits.after: Isolate you with Realm of Death for a stat-stealing 1v1

edits.before: Pull you in with Grasp of the Undying into ult
edits.after: Pull you in with Death's Grasp (E) into his ult

edits.after: Q-bite Mordekaiser as he steps up — he has no dash out — weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal his return damage.

notes: Obliterate carries a derived grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') that Riot's own description does not support; I did not write any grounding claim into either layer, matching the mirror's decision. Whether Realm of Death can be dodged by Infinite Duress' leap or vice versa (cast priority) is not in the kit text — left unstated.
